units.source_text: （六）此书内容，充分揭露了日本平安朝（九至十二世纪）初期封建统治阶级争权夺利、荒淫无度之相，

en.t: (6) The content of this book fully exposes the struggles for power and profit and the unrestrained decadence of the feudal ruling class in early Heian Japan, from the ninth to the twelfth century,

units.source_text: 反映了王朝贵族社会的矛盾及其日趋衰败之势。

en.t: and reflects the contradictions within aristocratic court society and its tendency toward increasing decline.

units.source_text: 当时皇家藤原氏一族势力强盛，仕宦不重实力，专靠出身及裙带关系。

en.t: At that time, the imperial Fujiwara clan was extremely powerful, and official careers depended not on ability but entirely on birth and personal connections.

units.source_text: 只要有一姐妹或女儿入宫或嫁与贵人，

en.t: So long as a sister or daughter entered the palace or married a noble person,

units.source_text: 其人便可升官发财，即所谓一人得道，鸡犬升天也。

en.t: that person could rise in office and grow wealthy; it was the old saying that when one person attains the way, even the chickens and dogs ascend to heaven.

units.source_text: 因此当时一切活动，皆以女性为中心。

en.t: For this reason, all activity at the time centered on women.

units.source_text: 凡女子必习和歌，通汉学，擅琴筝，方可侍奉贵人。

en.t: Every woman had to study waka poetry, be versed in Chinese learning, and be skilled at the qin and zither before she could serve a noble household.

units.source_text: 贵族之家若生女天资不高，则雇用许多富有才艺之侍女以辅助之。

en.t: If a daughter born into an aristocratic family lacked natural talent, the family would hire many accomplished ladies-in-waiting to support her.

units.source_text: 紫式部之时代，此风盛行达于极点。

en.t: In Murasaki Shikibu's time, this custom flourished to its fullest extent.

units.source_text: 此作者久居宫廷，耳闻目睹此种情状，故能委曲描写，成此巨著。

en.t: Because the author lived at court for a long time and personally heard and saw such circumstances, she was able to describe them in detail and create this great work.

units.source_text: 但作者本人亦贵族出身，故其文虽能如实揭露，有时也不免表示赞善与同情。

en.t: But the author herself was also of aristocratic birth, so although her writing could expose the truth, at times it inevitably expressed approval and sympathy as well.

units.source_text: 然其内容充实，技巧娴熟，文字古雅，故日本人尊此书为古典文学之泰斗也。

en.t: Nevertheless, because its content is rich, its technique mature, and its language classically elegant, Japanese people honor this book as a towering work of classical literature.
